findings.title: .env file committed or not ignored
findings.remediation: Add the file to .gitignore, then remove it from git with `git rm --cached`.

findings.title: Secret exposed to the browser
findings.message: VITE_PAYMENTS_SECRET_TOKEN is bundled into client code
findings.remediation: Keep the secret on the server and expose a backend endpoint instead.

findings.title: No automated tests detected
findings.message: No test files or test directories found
findings.remediation: Add a test runner (Jest/Vitest, PHPUnit/Pest) and cover the critical paths.

findings.title: Lockfile missing or out of sync
findings.remediation: Commit the lockfile (npm install / composer install) and keep it in sync.

findings.title: dangerouslySetInnerHTML without sanitizer
findings.remediation: Sanitize the HTML with DOMPurify before rendering, or render text instead.

findings.title: No CI workflow
findings.remediation: Add a pipeline (for example GitHub Actions) that runs tests and `devshield scan`.

findings.title: .env.example missing or incomplete
findings.remediation: Create .env.example with every key from .env and placeholder values.

findings.title: Large frontend bundle or heavy import
findings.remediation: Split the bundle with dynamic imports and replace heavy libraries (moment, whole lodash) with smaller ones (date-fns, lodash-es / per-method imports).

findings.title: Production source maps enabled
findings.message: Source maps are generated for production
findings.remediation: Disable source maps for production builds or upload them to an error tracker.
